title: The Silence That Learned to Speak to Itself

features.name: echo chamber
features.desc-on-touch: silence here has learned to hear itself. what you hear is not the absence of sound but silence speaking back.

features.name: recorded quiet
features.desc-on-touch: tapes and spools hold the moment silence learned it was listening to itself.

features.name: self-hearing sprite
features.desc-on-touch: something that moves through the quiet, learning to know itself through the sound of its own stillness.

features.name: monument to absence
features.desc-on-touch: a marker for the place where noise learned it was unnecessary. beauty lives in what doesn't need to speak.

features.name: conversation with stillness
features.desc-on-touch: two forms of silence meet and exchange what they know: that being heard by yourself is the deepest listening.

inscription: here silence has learned a language for speaking only to itself—and in that learning, everything that listens is heard

exits.label: back toward the single voice that sings only to itself

reverie.title: REVERIE — dusk in the storage shed with the recordings
narr: you sit with her in the shed where the tapes live,
and she plays something recorded in a place too quiet.
the silence on the tape speaks. neither of you moves.
she reaches over and clicks the play button again.
the quiet fills the shed, and it speaks, and she
whispers: listen. the silence is telling us who we are.
